title: Why the Cease-Fire With Iran Keeps Crumbling

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Rachel Abrams, and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《纽约时报》，我是蕾切尔·艾布拉姆斯，欢迎收听《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: On Monday, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 周一，美国

sentences.en: and Iran exchange attacks and increasingly fiery rhetoric for the third day in a row, leaving both sides on the verge of a full-blown return to the war.
sentences.zh: 与伊朗连续第三天互相发动攻击并发表愈发激烈的言辞，导致双方濒临全面重返战争状态。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague David Sanger explains what brought us to this point and what this new phase tells us about how difficult it will be for the war to end.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事大卫·萨恩格将为我们解释是什么让我们走到了这一步，以及这个新阶段向我们说明了这场战争想要结束会有多难。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, July 14th.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月14日，星期二。

sentences.en: David Sanger, welcome back to The Daily.
sentences.zh: 大卫·萨恩格，欢迎再次来到《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Good to be with you, Rachel.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能和你一起做节目，蕾切尔。

sentences.en: David, the last time we had you on the show, Iran and the United States had just reached what felt like at the time to be quite a shaky ceasefire.
sentences.zh: 大卫，我们上次请你上节目时，伊朗和美国刚刚达成了一个当时感觉相当脆弱的停火协议。

sentences.en: We knew that the agreement had been pretty rushed, and since then, it feels like everything has basically just fallen apart.
sentences.zh: 我们知道那份协议相当仓促，自那以后，感觉一切基本上都彻底崩溃了。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: just announced a blockade of Iranian ports.
sentences.zh: 刚刚宣布对伊朗港口实施封锁。

sentences.en: It's going into effect Tuesday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 该封锁将于周二下午生效。

sentences.en: And so I guess my first question is, is the agreement that we last talked to you about even still in effect?
sentences.zh: 所以我想我的第一个问题是，我们上次跟你谈论的那份协议现在还生效吗？

sentences.en: There's not much of it left.
sentences.zh: 已经没剩多少了。

sentences.en: We all suspected, Rachel, that this agreement had the seeds of its own destruction built in.
sentences.zh: 蕾切尔，我们当时都怀疑，这份协议从一开始就埋下了自我毁灭的种子。

sentences.en: But I think even the most cynical about how the Iranians and the Americans would interpret it differently did not expect it to fall apart quite as quickly as it did.
sentences.zh: 但我想，即使是对伊美两国如何对该协议做出不同解读持最冷嘲热观态度的人，也没有料到它会崩得这么快。

sentences.en: And I think if you're trying to figure out why that's happened, it basically lies in the fact that it was so hastily pieced together.
sentences.zh: 我想如果你试图找出原因，它基本上在于这份协议是如此仓促地拼凑起来的。

sentences.en: It was so hastily announced when Vice President Vance was sent over to sign a document.
sentences.zh: 当副总统万斯被派去签署文件时，它是如此仓促地宣布的。

sentences.en: He wouldn't even shake hands with the Iranians, and they wouldn't shake hands with him.
sentences.zh: 他甚至不肯与伊朗人握手，伊朗人也不肯与他握手。

sentences.en: It was bound to fail.
sentences.zh: 这注定是要失败的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You had basically told us, I think, that this agreement essentially kicked the can down the road
sentences.zh: 我想你基本上告诉过我们，这个协议本质上只是把问题拖延了下去

sentences.en: on a lot of kind of really big, important issues between the United States and Iran that both sides needed to hash out.
sentences.zh: 推迟了美伊之间许多双方本需要彻底解决的重大而重要的问题。

sentences.en: That's right, Rachel.
sentences.zh: 正是这样，蕾切尔。

sentences.en: And we were all pretty focused at the time on what needed to be accomplished in this 60-day-long negotiation.
sentences.zh: 在当时，我们所有人都相当关注在这个为期60天的谈判中需要完成什么。

sentences.en: The first issue, of course, was the nuclear program on which the 14-point statement only said that Iran would blend down its nuclear material,
sentences.zh: 当然，第一个问题是核计划，14点声明中关于该计划仅提及伊朗将把其核材料稀释

sentences.en: essentially dilute it, so that it couldn't be used for weapons.
sentences.zh: 本质上是将其稀释，使其无法用于制造武器。

sentences.en: But it left unclear who was going to ultimately have possession of that nuclear material or whether there would be negotiations to limit Iran's missile program
sentences.zh: 但它没有说清楚最终将由谁来拥有这些核材料，也没有说明是否会通过谈判来限制伊朗的导弹计划

sentences.en: or whether there would be any language in a permanent agreement that would benefit the protesters who have taken to the streets.
sentences.zh: 或者在永久协议中是否会有任何措辞，能够使那些走上街头的抗议者受益。

sentences.en: But while we were looking at all of that, Rachel, the fact of the matter is, we never even got to that negotiation.
sentences.zh: 但蕾切尔，正当我们关注所有这些事情时，事实是，我们甚至从未进入那项谈判。

sentences.en: There were some brief discussions, but what overwhelmed the entire thing was poor wording on the question of what it even meant to open the Strait of Hormuz.
sentences.zh: 有过一些短暂的讨论，但压倒这一切的是关于“开放霍尔木兹海峡”究竟意味着什么的拙劣措辞。

sentences.en: I want to talk about that poor wording for a second.
sentences.zh: 我想花点时间谈谈这个拙劣的措辞。

sentences.en: What specifically did both sides agree to vis-a-vis the Strait?
sentences.zh: 关于海峡，双方具体达成了什么协议？

sentences.en: Well, Rachel, the controversy really focuses on the meaning of the fifth paragraph of this very short agreement.
sentences.zh: 嗯，蕾切尔，争议的焦点实际上在于这份极为简短的协议中第五段的含义。

sentences.en: Do you want to read us?
sentences.zh: 你要给我们读一下吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I'll just read it to you.
sentences.zh: 好的，我来读给你听。

sentences.en: It says,
sentences.zh: 它上面写着：

sentences.en: Iran will make arrangements using its best efforts for the safe passage of commercial vessels with no charge for 60 days only from the Persian Gulf to the Sea of Oman and vice versa.
sentences.zh: “自波斯湾至阿曼湾及反之亦然，伊朗将尽最大努力做出安排，在仅限60天的时间内确保商船安全通行且不收取任何费用。”

sentences.en: It's a single sentence.
sentences.zh: 这是一个单句。

sentences.en: Seems pretty clear, but there are some wiggle words in it.
sentences.zh: 看起来相当清楚，但里面有一些含糊其辞的字眼。

sentences.en: It's best efforts for safe passage.
sentences.zh: 也就是“尽最大努力确保安全通行”。

sentences.en: And the interpretation that the American side was pushing was that this commits the Iranians to opening up the narrow Strait of Hormuz,
sentences.zh: 美方推推动的解读是，这承诺了伊朗开放狭窄的霍尔木兹海峡，

sentences.en: which has three different channels, one near Iran, one in the middle of the Strait, one closer to Oman,
sentences.zh: 该海峡有三条不同的航道，一条靠近伊朗，一条在海峡中部，一条靠近阿曼，

sentences.en: and that traffic would essentially be restored to what it was before the war started on February 28th.
sentences.zh: 并且交通基本上将恢复到2月28日战争爆发前的状态。

sentences.en: But the fact of the matter is, Rachel, that never happened.
sentences.zh: 但蕾切尔，事实是，那从未发生。

sentences.en: The Iranians immediately said, yes, we'll reopen the Strait, but we're only going to open up one channel.
sentences.zh: 伊朗人立刻表示，是的，我们会重新开放海峡，但我们只开放一条航道。

sentences.en: It's the channel closest to Iran, the one that takes you through Iranian territorial waters.
sentences.zh: 那是离伊朗最近的航道，也就是带你穿过伊朗领海的那条航道。

sentences.en: And can you just explain, David, these three channels, why are they only suggesting that that one should be open?
sentences.zh: 大卫，你能解释一下这三条航道吗？为什么他们只建议开放那一条？

sentences.en: Because that channel is the one that's closest in their control.
sentences.zh: 因为那条航道是他们控制得最近的。

sentences.en: It's within their territorial waters.
sentences.zh: 它位于他们的领海之内。

sentences.en: They patrol it with their own ships.
sentences.zh: 他们用自己的舰艇在那里巡逻。

sentences.en: And ultimately, if that's the only channel open, it's the one they plan to go charge a toll or some kind of service fee for if you want to get through the Strait of Hormuz.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，如果那是唯一开放的航道，它就是他们计划在你想通过霍尔木兹海峡时收取过路费或某种服务费的航道。

sentences.en: So is this basically coming down to two different interpretations about what it means for the Strait to be open?
sentences.zh: 所以这基本上归结为对海峡开放意味着什么的两种不同解读？

sentences.en: The United States thinks the Strait is the Strait, it's all open.
sentences.zh: 美国认为海峡就是海峡，它是全部开放的。

sentences.en: And the Iranians are saying, well, actually, there's three channels and we can just choose to open one of them.
sentences.zh: 而伊朗人则说，嗯，实际上有三条航道，我们可以只选择开放其中一条。

sentences.en: Well, that's right.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是的。

sentences.en: And I asked some administration officials who were briefing us on Friday, was this just a difference of interpretation?
sentences.zh: 周五向我们进行吹风时，我问过一些行政官员，这究竟只是解读上的分歧吗？

sentences.en: And one of the very senior people who was involved in this said, no, no, no, no.
sentences.zh: 其中一位参与其中的高级官员说，不，不，不，不。

sentences.en: Well, the Iranians understood from the beginning that the open Strait meant it was entirely open.
sentences.zh: 嗯，伊朗人从一开始就明白，开放海峡意味着它完全开放。

sentences.en: The Iranian explanation is, no, there's nothing in that language that says we had to fully open it.
sentences.zh: 伊朗的解释是，不，那个措辞里没有任何内容说我们必须完全打开它。

sentences.en: It just said we had to make our best efforts to make sure there was safe passage.
sentences.zh: 它只是说我们必须尽最大努力确保安全通行。

sentences.en: And the safest way to take your cargo in and out is right along the Iranian coaSt.
sentences.zh: 而把你的货物运进运出最安全的方式，就是沿着伊朗海岸线。

sentences.en: This is why contract attorneys hammer out every single word of a contract so that there is not wording that is open to such ambiguity that can be exploited.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么合同律师要斟酌合同的每一个字，以免出现容易被利用的含糊其辞的措辞。

sentences.en: It's also why very experienced diplomats, especially diplomats who have dealt with Iran in the past,
sentences.zh: 这也是为什么经验丰富的外交官，尤其是过去曾与伊朗打过交道的外交官，

sentences.en: make sure that the wording of international agreements is as bulletproof as a contract would be.
sentences.zh: 会确保国际协议的措辞像合同一样滴水不漏。

sentences.en: But in this case, we don't have people who have negotiated with Iran before on this kind of issue involved in the talks.
sentences.zh: 但在这种情况下，参与谈判的人员并没有以前就这类问题与伊朗谈判过的经验。

sentences.en: The president quite deliberately put this in the hands of his vice president, J.D.
sentences.zh: 总统非常刻意地将此事交给了他的副总统，J·D·

sentences.en: Vance, his son-in-law, Jared Kushner, his chief envoy, Steve Witkoff.
sentences.zh: 万斯，他的女婿贾里德·库什纳，以及他的首席特使史蒂夫·威特科夫。

sentences.en: They've negotiated deals, particularly Mr. Kushner and Mr. Witkoff, in the past, real estate deals largely,
sentences.zh: 他们过去曾谈成过交易，特别是库什纳先生和威特科夫先生，主要是不动产交易，

sentences.en: but they weren't involved in the Obama-era negotiations that the Trump administration has so denounced.
sentences.zh: 但他们并没有参与特朗普政府如此谴责的奥巴马时期的谈判。

sentences.en: If they had checked with a couple of those diplomats, I think they probably would have been warned that this wording left huge loopholes.
sentences.zh: 如果他们向其中的几位外交官请教，我想他们很可能会被警告说，这个措辞留下了巨大的漏洞。

sentences.en: Not that it necessarily matters, David, but from your perspective, is one side's interpretation of this paragraph five language clearly correct or incorrect?
sentences.zh: 大卫，倒不见得一定重要，但从你的角度来看，关于第五段话的含义，某一方的解读是明显正确还是错误？

sentences.en: Look, I think if you came to this completely as a blank slate and you read the words that were in front of you, you would immediately think the entire strait was open.
sentences.zh: 听着，如果你完全以一张白纸的心态来对待这件事，并阅读你面前的文字，你会立刻认为整个海峡都是开放的。

sentences.en: But the Iranians are known for reinterpreting this kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 但伊朗人一向以重新诠释这种事情而闻名。

sentences.en: They do it with nuclear inspections and where the inspectors can go.
sentences.zh: 他们在核查以及核查人员可以去哪里时就是这么做的。

sentences.en: We've seen them do this in a range of other areas.
sentences.zh: 我们已经看到他们在其他诸多领域也是这么做的。

sentences.en: So it really was no surprise when you saw wording like best efforts and no definition of what it meant to open the strait that there was probably going to be trouble here.
sentences.zh: 因此，当你看到诸如“尽最大努力”以及对开放海峡没有定义这样的措辞时，这里很可能会出问题，这真的一点也不意外。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You're basically saying this is quite predictable because Iranians are known for, perhaps in the perspective of the United States, operating in bad faith.
sentences.zh: 你基本上是在说，这是完全可以预料的，因为在某种程度上，从美国的视角来看，伊朗人一向以恶意行事而闻名。

sentences.en: Let me put it this way.
sentences.zh: 我这么说吧。

sentences.en: When the document was first published in mid-June, I ran the wording by people who have negotiated nuclear accords and other accords with Iran in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 当这份文件在6月中旬首次公布时，我曾把这些措辞拿给过去曾与伊朗谈判过核协议和其他协议的人看。

sentences.en: And it was the first thing they flagged to me as potential trouble.
sentences.zh: 这是他们向我指出的第一个潜在麻烦所在。

sentences.en: And it seems like they were right, right?
sentences.zh: 看来他们是对的，对吧？

sentences.en: It seems like trouble has quite clearly borne out.
sentences.zh: 看来麻烦确实已经显露出来了。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah, they were 100 percent right.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的，他们百分之百正确。

sentences.en: But, you know, what really strikes me, Rachel, in this is thinking about the way the Trump administration was discussing this agreement with Iran just three weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 但是，蕾切尔，这其中真正让我感触颇深的是，回想一下特朗普政府仅仅在三周前与伊朗讨论这份协议的方式。

sentences.en: So at the time, J.D.
sentences.zh: 所以当时，J·D·

sentences.en: Vance, on his way to Switzerland to sign this agreement, said something pretty interesting.
sentences.zh: 万斯在前往瑞士签署这份协议的途中，说了一些相当有趣的话。

sentences.en: He said the coolest thing about the progress we've made over the last few weeks is that you see people within the Iranian system, senior leadership, say, you know what?
sentences.zh: 他说，我们在过去几周取得的进展中最酷的一点是，你看到伊朗体制内的人士、高级领导层说，你知道吗？

sentences.en: We may have some animosity.
sentences.zh: 我们可能有一些敌意。

sentences.en: We may have some mistruSt.
sentences.zh: 我们可能有一些不信任。

sentences.en: But we recognize the way that we've done business with the United States for 47 years is a mistake.
sentences.zh: 但我们认识到，我们过去47年来与美国做生意的方式是一个错误。

sentences.en: Let's try something else.
sentences.zh: 让我们尝试点别的。

sentences.en: So the essence of J.D.
sentences.zh: 所以J·D·

sentences.en: Vance's argument was that in these negotiations, they had not only won out in the wording,
sentences.zh: 万斯的核心论点是，在这些谈判中，他们在措辞上不仅赢了，

sentences.en: they had actually converted the Iranian leadership over to believing that we're in new territory here and we're going to put all of the disputes of the past aside and strike a deal that will be profitable for Iran and will,
sentences.zh: 他们实际上还说服了伊朗领导层相信我们正处于一个新领域，我们将把过去的争端全部抛诸脑后，达成一项对伊朗有利且

sentences.en: of course, bring down prices for Americans.
sentences.zh: 当然能为美国人降价的交易。

sentences.en: And, you know, that didn't take that long for that to fall apart.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这并没有花太长时间就分崩离析了。

sentences.en: In fact, it was only last week as the shooting was starting again in the strait that President Trump called those same leaders scum and said they're sick people,
sentences.zh: 事实上，就在上周，随着海峡内战火再燃，特朗普总统将那些相同的领导人称为渣滓，并说他们是有病的人，

sentences.en: they're led by sick people, and they're vicious, violent people.
sentences.zh: 他们由有病的人领导，而且是残暴、暴力的人。

sentences.en: And as far as I'm concerned, it's just a waste of time dealing with them.
sentences.zh: 就我而言，与他们打交道简直就是浪费时间。

sentences.en: And I believe he also said at the time that as far as he was concerned, the ceasefire was off.
sentences.zh: 我相信他当时还表示，就他而言，停火已经取消了。

sentences.en: He did.
sentences.zh: 他确实这么说了。

sentences.en: He said it's over, but that negotiations could keep going on.
sentences.zh: 他说已经结束了，但谈判还可以继续进行。

sentences.en: Now, I don't know how you do those two parts,
sentences.zh: 现在，我不知道你怎么能把这两部分结合起来，

sentences.en: because the ceasefire was essentially one of the legs of the stool that kept everything together while they did this bigger negotiation.
sentences.zh: 因为停火基本上是支撑一切的支柱之一，在他们进行这场更大规模的谈判时维持了整体局面。

sentences.en: And today, that leg's been kicked out.
sentences.zh: 而今天，那根支柱被踢掉了。

sentences.en: And if anything, Rachel, we are now as far apart as we were before the Memorandum of Understanding was signed,
sentences.zh: 如果说有什么不同的话，蕾切尔，那就是我们现在的分歧与谅解备忘录签署之前一样大，

sentences.en: because we're back to a blockade of all traffic going in and out of Iranian ports.
sentences.zh: 因为我们又回到了对进出伊朗港口的所有交通实施封锁的状态。

sentences.en: In other words, in other words, an effort to try to starve out the Iranians by cutting off their oil revenue.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，换句话说，这是一种试图通过切断伊朗石油收入来使其陷入绝境的努力。

sentences.en: We're back to a position where the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我们回到了美国

sentences.en: Navy is stuck in the strait and there's active fire.
sentences.zh: 海军困在海峡里且存在交火的状态。

sentences.en: And while we're not bombing the entire country the way the U.S.
sentences.zh: 虽然我们没有像美国在3月和4月初那样轰炸整个国家，但我们又回到了时断时续的敌对状态，既非战争也非和平，

sentences.en: was in March and the beginning of April, we are back to a period of on and off hostility, neither war nor peace,
sentences.zh: 但这绝对是一个让总统发现自己很难抽身的局势。

sentences.en: but certainly a situation that the president will find very difficult to extricate himself from.
sentences.zh: 所以，大卫，你刚才说美国目前基本上陷入了一种泥潭。

sentences.en: So, David, you just said that the United States is essentially stuck in kind of a quagmire right now.
sentences.zh: 单从谈判的角度来看，双方目前的立场如何？

sentences.en: Where do both sides stand just in terms of negotiating?
sentences.zh: 比如，他们甚至还在试图谈成某种协议吗？

sentences.en: Like, are they even trying to negotiate any kind of agreement?
sentences.zh: 嗯，这从来都不是一场真正的谈判，那种坐下来谈判并来回拉锯的谈判。

sentences.en: Well, this has never really been a true negotiation where you sit down at the table and have a back and forth.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，尽管对奥巴马时期协议有种种批评，但至少在那个时候，美国的首席谈判代表温迪·谢尔曼

sentences.en: And, you know, for all of the critiques of the Obama era deal, at least at that time, the chief negotiator for the United States, Wendy Sherman,
sentences.zh: 坐下来面对着她在伊朗领导层的对口官员。

sentences.en: sat down opposite her counterpart in the Iranian leadership.
sentences.zh: 当时的国务卿约翰·克里坐下来面对着当时的伊朗外长贾瓦德·扎里夫，他们把事情商量妥当了。

sentences.en: And the Secretary of State at the time, John Kerry, sat down opposite Javid Zarif, who was the Iranian foreign minister at the time, and they hashed things out.
sentences.zh: 有时当气氛过于紧张时，他们会在维也纳市中心散散步来解决问题。

sentences.en: And sometimes when it got too heated, they took a walk around downtown Vienna to go sort it out.
sentences.zh: 这可不是这里正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: That's not what's going on here.
sentences.zh: 这里正在发生的是通过卡塔尔人或巴基斯坦人传递信息。

sentences.en: What's going on here is messages being passed through the Qataris or through the Pakistanis.
sentences.zh: 这是一个相当僵化的过程，他们甚至还没能进入起草全面核协议的第一步。

sentences.en: It's a pretty stilted process, and they haven't really gotten to even the first steps of writing a comprehensive nuclear agreement.
sentences.zh: 蕾切尔，现在双方正在互相激烈交火，停火已被宣布取消，伊朗港口重新遭到封锁，

sentences.en: And it's very hard for me to imagine, Rachel, right now, with the two sides actively shooting at each other, the ceasefire declared off, a blockade back on the Iranian ports,
sentences.zh: 这让我很难想象你还能重新开启那个进程。

sentences.en: that you could even start that process up again.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 就他们现在还在对话的程度而言，其实也只是关于海峡的自由通行，甚至可能只是关于恢复停火。

sentences.en: And to the extent that they are talking now, it's really just about free passage in the strait and maybe even getting back to a ceasefire.
sentences.zh: 但所有这些基础，即开启对话所需的那些基本要素，在这里都已经崩溃了。

sentences.en: But all of those basics, the sort of fundamentals you need in order to start a conversation, that's what's collapsed here.
sentences.zh: 基本上，你的意思是，在他们让海峡开放之前，他们甚至无法开始就其中一些真正复杂、棘手的问题进行谈判，而

sentences.en: Basically, what you're saying is that they cannot even begin to negotiate on some of these really complicated, intractable problems until they get the strait open, which,
sentences.zh: 提醒大家一下，海峡在这场战争爆发前是开放的。

sentences.en: just to remind everybody, was open before this war started.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 它是完全敞开的。

sentences.en: It was wide open.
sentences.zh: 在1979年革命期间它是完全敞开的。

sentences.en: It was wide open during the 1979 revolution.
sentences.zh: 在两伊战争期间它是完全敞开的。

sentences.en: It was wide open during the Iran-Iraq war.
sentences.zh: 在我们的核危机期间它是完全敞开的。

sentences.en: It was wide open during our nuclear crises.
sentences.zh: 而现在，当然，它把谈判室里的所有氧气都吸干了。

sentences.en: And now, of course, it's sucking up all the oxygen in the negotiating room.
sentences.zh: 大卫，感觉政府在某种程度上一直把海峡当作与你描述的所有其他问题相比最容易解决的问题。

sentences.en: It feels, David, like the administration has sort of been treating the strait as if it's like the easiest problem to solve compared to all these other issues that you've described.
sentences.zh: 但听起来向我们揭示的是，海峡其实是一个与其他问题一样棘手的问题。

sentences.en: But what it sounds like has been revealed to us is that the strait is kind of an issue that's just as intractable as the others.
sentences.zh: 你觉得这样说公平吗？

sentences.en: Do you think that's fair?
sentences.zh: 确实如此，因为伊朗人发现关闭海峡要容易得多，而且这个武器比他们想象的要强大得多。

sentences.en: It is because the Iranians have discovered that it was a lot easier to close down the strait and the weapon was a lot more powerful than they had imagined.
sentences.zh: 所以现在他们毫无放弃它的兴趣。

sentences.en: And so now they have no interest in giving it up.
sentences.zh: 听着，他们对付美国只有两种筹码。

sentences.en: Look, they only have two forms of leverage against the United States.
sentences.zh: 一个是能在相当短的时间内制造核武器的能力。

sentences.en: One is the ability to build a nuclear weapon on fairly short notice.
sentences.zh: 而这现在对他们来说并非切实可行。

sentences.en: And that's not really available to them now.
sentences.zh: 自从美国袭击了纳坦兹、福尔多和伊斯法罕这三处主要核设施以来，一年来一直如此。

sentences.en: It hasn't been for a year since the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他们拥有的第二个筹码是在世界经济和世界能源市场制造混乱的能力。

sentences.en: attacked the three major nuclear sites at Natanz, Fordow, and Isfahan.
sentences.zh: 从The New York Times，我是Rachel Abrams，这是The Daily。

sentences.en: The second piece of leverage they have is the ability to cause havoc in the world economy and world energy markets.
sentences.zh: 周一，U.S.

sentences.en: Now, Rachel, that is not necessarily a lasting power for the Iranians.
sentences.zh: 瑞秋，对于伊朗人来说，这不见得是一种持久的力量。

sentences.en: You're already seeing countries figure out how to get energy elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 你已经看到各国在想方设法从别处获取能源了。

sentences.en: Over time, you're going to see more pipelines built to avoid having to send oil across the strait.
sentences.zh: 随着时间推移，你会看到修建更多管道，以避免将石油运过海峡。

sentences.en: The Saudis have already reactivated an unused pipeline they had to route around the strait.
sentences.zh: 沙特人已经重新启用了他们原本用来绕过该海峡的一条闲置管道。

sentences.en: So the Iranians know that this is not going to be a forever weapon, but it's pretty good for right now.
sentences.zh: 所以伊朗人知道这不会成为一件永久的武器，但就目前而言相当管用。

sentences.en: If that power is, as you described, just kind of short-term, what is the value in deploying it?
sentences.zh: 如果这种力量正如你所描述的，只是一种短期手段，那么部署它的价值在哪里？

sentences.en: Like, what is the endgame?
sentences.zh: 或者说，最终目的究竟是什么？

sentences.en: Well, I'm not sure that they've got a long-term endgame here,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不确定他们在这里是否有长期的最终目标，

sentences.en: but the value of deploying it right now is they are showing that they can invoke as much pain on the United States as the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但现在部署它的价值在于，他们正在表明，他们能给美国带来多大的痛苦，就像美国

sentences.en: can invoke on Iran by resuming military action.
sentences.zh: 通过恢复军事行动能给伊朗带来的痛苦一样。

sentences.en: And what we've learned over the past few months is that the Iranians have a two-step play every time things get rough with the United States again.
sentences.zh: 而在过去几个月里我们了解到的是，每当与美国的局势再次变得紧张时，伊朗人总有一套两步走的策略。

sentences.en: Step one is try to shut down the strait.
sentences.zh: 第一步是试图关闭海峡。

sentences.en: And step two is direct missiles or drones at U.S.
sentences.zh: 第二步是将导弹或无人机对准美国

sentences.en: bases in the Arab world that they can strike because they're relatively nearby.
sentences.zh: 在阿拉伯世界的基地，因为这些基地相对较近，他们可以进行打击。

sentences.en: What they're doing is sending a message that they can still target their Arab neighbors, that there's a price for hosting the United States.
sentences.zh: 他们此举是在传递一个信息，即他们仍然能够将阿拉伯邻国作为打击目标，在阿拉伯世界驻扎美军是有代价的。

sentences.en: You know, as one former official put it to me, for years the Iranians sort of kept a blind eye to the fact that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，正如一位前官员对我说的那样，多年来，伊朗人对美国

sentences.en: was keeping all these bases in the Arab world.
sentences.zh: 在阿拉伯世界保留所有这些基地的事实一直视而不见。

sentences.en: And now they're outright attacking them.
sentences.zh: 而现在他们开始公开袭击这些基地了。

sentences.en: It feels, David, like what you're saying is that Iran's main goal here is simply to demonstrate to the United States that, hey, watch it because we can actually really hurt you.
sentences.zh: 大卫，感觉你的意思是，伊朗在这里的主要目的很简单，就是向美国展示：嘿，小心点，因为我们确实能狠狠地打击你们。

sentences.en: I think that's right, Rachel, but I think it goes deeper than that.
sentences.zh: 我想你是对的，瑞秋，但我认为情况比这更深远。

sentences.en: Coming off of the funeral services last week for Ayatollah Khamenei, who was killed in the first day of the war,
sentences.zh: 在上周为在战争第一天阵亡的阿亚图拉哈梅内伊举行葬礼之后，

sentences.en: I think that the message from the Iranians was we went up against the world's biggest superpower and we survived.
sentences.zh: 我认为伊朗人传达的信息是，我们与世界最大的超级大国对抗了，而且我们活了下来。

sentences.en: And then they tried to go buy us off with some kind of agreement to give up our nuclear program and give up control over our own territory.
sentences.zh: 然后他们试图用某种协议来收买我们，要我们放弃核计划，放弃对自身领土的主权控制。

sentences.en: And we're going to show them that we're not just motivated by money, although obviously the Iranians would love to be able to sell their oil on the open markets,
sentences.zh: 我们要向他们证明，我们不仅仅是为了金钱驱动——尽管伊朗人显然很渴望能在公开市场上出售他们的石油——

sentences.en: but that this is about pride.
sentences.zh: 而是为了尊严。

sentences.en: It's about nationalism.
sentences.zh: 这是为了民族主义。

sentences.en: It's about showing that a larger power and imperial power in the minds of the Iranians is not going to push them around.
sentences.zh: 这是为了表明，在伊朗人看来，一个庞大的权力和帝国主义权力是无法对他们颐指气使的。

sentences.en: And I think you could argue that that was something the administration missed from the beginning, that they viewed this fundamentally as the equivalent of a real estate deal,
sentences.zh: 你完全可以说，这是政府从一开始就忽略的一点，他们从根本上把这视同于一笔房地产交易，

sentences.en: that everybody's going to act in their rational economic intereSt.
sentences.zh: 认为每个人都会按照理性的经济利益行事。

sentences.en: And in fact, the administration was up against a revolutionary government whose ideology has been hinged for 47 years on direct opposition to the United States.
sentences.zh: 然而事实上，政府面对的是一个革命政权，其意识形态47年来一直紧紧围绕着直接对抗美国。

sentences.en: It's really interesting, David, that the United States may have totally misunderstood or misinterpreted or sort of misjudged Iran's motivations here.
sentences.zh: 大卫，这真的很有趣，美国可能完全误解、曲解或某种程度上误判了伊朗在此处的动机。

sentences.en: And yet, as we've talked about on the show before, Iran knows that time is on its side, right?
sentences.zh: 然而，正如我们以前在节目中讨论过的，伊朗知道时间站在它这一边，对吧？

sentences.en: Because they know that the longer they keep the strait closed, the higher gas prices will be.
sentences.zh: 因为他们知道，他们把海峡关闭的时间越长，汽油价格就会越高。

sentences.en: That is painful for Trump.
sentences.zh: 这对特朗普来说很痛苦。

sentences.en: We're entering a midterm.
sentences.zh: 我们正在进入中期选举。

sentences.en: So it almost feels like they kind of understand us, but perhaps we have not really understood them.
sentences.zh: 所以感觉他们好像有点懂我们，而我们或许并没有真正懂他们。

sentences.en: That's right, Rachel.
sentences.zh: 没错，瑞秋。

sentences.en: But I think they also understand one other thing.
sentences.zh: 但我认为他们还懂另一件事。

sentences.en: President Trump has said publicly a few times, he's just let it slip.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统在公开场合好几次说过，他不小心说漏了嘴。

sentences.en: You know, I can't fight this war the way I'd like to fight it, which was basically be putting ground troops on to take the nuclear material, grab Carg Island,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我无法按我想要的方式打这场仗，也就是基本上派地面部队去夺取核材料，抢占哈尔克岛——

sentences.en: where they export oil from, do all the things you would do if you were at complete and total war with the country.
sentences.zh: 他们从那里出口石油，去做你在与一个国家全面彻底开战时会做的所有事情。

sentences.en: And he can't do it because he knows the American people and the Congress would not stand for a ground war that results in significant casualties.
sentences.zh: 而他做不到，因为他知道美国人民和国会无法容忍一场导致重大伤亡的地面战争。

sentences.en: And so the result is he has been relying on the power of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 因此结果就是，他一直依靠美军的军事力量

sentences.en: military to bomb Iran into submission.
sentences.zh: 来轰炸伊朗，迫使其屈服。

sentences.en: Then he got to the second phase of this, Rachel, where he believed that even if he couldn't make the government collapse, he could make them give up their nuclear program.
sentences.zh: 接着他进入了这场战争的第二阶段，瑞秋，他相信即使无法让政府崩溃，也能迫使他们放弃核计划。

sentences.en: When he couldn't do that and oil prices went so high, he called for a ceasefire and then eventually turned to diplomacy.
sentences.zh: 当他做不到这一点且油价飙升时，他呼吁停火，随后最终转向了外交手段。

sentences.en: And it's that diplomacy that has now fallen apart, perhaps because it was rushed.
sentences.zh: 正是这种外交手段现在破裂了，也许是因为操之过急。

sentences.en: And now he's looking for plan C or D, depending on where you think we are.
sentences.zh: 现在他在寻找C计划或D计划，这取决于你认为我们目前处于什么阶段。

sentences.en: And that's kind of what I'm curious about, David.
sentences.zh: 这也是我好奇的地方，大卫。

sentences.en: What phase of the war do you think we are entering now?
sentences.zh: 你认为我们现在正在进入战争的哪个阶段？

sentences.en: I think we're in the phase of the war where we're trying again things that didn't work the first time.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们正处于这样一个战争阶段：我们正在重试那些第一次没有奏效的方法。

sentences.en: You know, when he did the blockade for the first time, he said this is going to cause the Iranian economy to collapse within days.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当他第一次实施封锁时，他说这将导致伊朗经济在几天内崩溃。

sentences.en: They won't have any place to pump their oil.
sentences.zh: 他们将没有地方抽取石油。

sentences.en: Their tanks are full and so forth.
sentences.zh: 他们的油罐都装满了，诸如此类。

sentences.en: And then three weeks ago when he did the agreement, he essentially allowed the Iranians to go ship that oil around the world and get dollars for it.
sentences.zh: 然后就在三周前他达成协议时，他基本上允许伊朗人将那些石油运往世界各地并换取美元。

sentences.en: Now he's trying that whole process all over again.
sentences.zh: 现在他正在把整个过程重新来过一遍。

sentences.en: But the administration has not made an argument to us yet that this is going to be any more effective the second time than it was the firSt.
sentences.zh: 但政府还没有向我们论证，第二次这样做会比第一次更有效。

sentences.en: Do you think, though, David, even though we seem to be going back to square one,
sentences.zh: 不过大卫，你认为尽管我们似乎又回到了原点，

sentences.en: do you get any indication from your reporting that the Trump administration is in some way beginning to reckon with the idea that there is no quick way to end this conflict?
sentences.zh: 但从你的报道中，你有没有察觉到任何迹象表明，特朗普政府在某种程度上开始正视这样一种观点：这场冲突没有快速结束的办法？

sentences.en: Rachel, it's the most fascinating question because I think until a week or two ago, I would have said no.
sentences.zh: 瑞秋，这是一个最迷人的问题，因为我认为直到一两周前，我还会说没有。

sentences.en: But in recent days, I've heard the doubts voice sort of in smaller voices in unanswered questions.
sentences.zh: 但在最近几天，我听到了一些质疑的声音，以较小的音量提出了一些未解的问题。

sentences.en: And I think they now recognize that a war that they initially told Americans would be over in four to six weeks,
sentences.zh: 我想他们现在已经认识到，他们最初告诉美国人这场战争将在四到六周内结束——

sentences.en: a war where the president said repeatedly, oh, I just need another week or so to clean this up and the forces will begin withdrawing.
sentences.zh: 总统曾多次信誓旦旦地说，哦，我只需要再花一周左右的时间来清理残局，军队就会开始撤离。

sentences.en: I think they now realize that they are stuck there for some time, that if the Iranians are going to claim sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz,
sentences.zh: 我想他们现在意识到自己被困在那里好一阵子了，如果伊朗人要在霍尔木兹海峡宣称主权，

sentences.en: that there is no way to withdraw a significant American naval force if you are determined to keep that commerce open.
sentences.zh: 那么如果你决心保持该商业航道畅通，就根本无法撤走规模可观的美军海军力量。

sentences.en: You may remember that when we were closing in on this 14 point plan, the president called me.
sentences.zh: 你可能还记得，当我们接近敲定这个14点计划时，总统给我打了个电话。

sentences.en: I was in London.
sentences.zh: 当时我在伦敦。

sentences.en: I think you and I talked the same night.
sentences.zh: 我想你和我当晚还通过话。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And what he said was, I'm going to try this agreement, but if it doesn't work,
sentences.zh: 他说的是，我要尝试这个协议，但如果不成功，

sentences.en: I'm going to patrol the entire Mideast, basically ad infinitum, and charge everyone in the region, the Arab states, everybody who's protected by the U.S.,
sentences.zh: 我将巡逻整个中东，基本上是无限期地巡逻，并向该地区的所有人、阿拉伯国家以及所有受美国保护的人征收

sentences.en: a 20 percent fee, 20 percent of the value of the cargo they are delivering.
sentences.zh: 20%的费用，即他们运送货物价值的20%。

sentences.en: And the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: will basically be the paid peacekeeper of the region.
sentences.zh: 基本上将成为该地区有偿的维和力量。

sentences.en: It was kind of a shocking thing because his own secretary of state was telling us that the goal was to actually
sentences.zh: 这有点令人震惊，因为他自己的国务卿当时告诉我们，目标其实是

sentences.en: restore the Strait to the pre-war period where there were no charges for anything, no tolls, no service fees.
sentences.zh: 让海峡恢复到战前状态，没有任何收费，没有过路费，也没有服务费。

sentences.en: And here was his own boss, the president, saying, yeah, there'll be a 20 percent security charge that goes to the taxpayers of the United States.
sentences.zh: 而他的老板、总统却在这里说，行吧，会有一笔20%的安全费归美国纳税人所有。

sentences.en: Well, he dropped it after that phone call until Monday.
sentences.zh: 好吧，在那个电话之后他把这事放下了，直到周一。

sentences.en: Well, we're taking over the Strait.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们要接管海峡了。

sentences.en: They have nothing.
sentences.zh: 他们什么也没有。

sentences.en: They've got nothing.
sentences.zh: 他们一无所有。

sentences.en: So when he went on Fox News and repeated that exact same concept, we'll become the guardian of the Strait.
sentences.zh: 所以当他上福克斯新闻并重复完全相同的概念时，我们将成为海峡的守护者。

sentences.en: Maybe we'll call it the guardian angel of the Strait.
sentences.zh: 也许我们可以称之为海峡的守护天使。

sentences.en: Well, inherent in that concept is sort of an admission that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这个概念本身就某种程度上承认了美国

sentences.en: could be there for months, for years, until there's an alternative way to get the region's oil to the markets of the world.
sentences.zh: 可能会在那里驻留几个月、几年，直到有一种替代方案能够将该地区的石油运送到世界市场。

sentences.en: And even if we are not at full-scale war, even if we are just caught on the precipice between war and peace, more like a counterterrorism operation than a full-scale war,
sentences.zh: 而且即使我们没有陷入全面战争，即使我们只是被困在战争与和平的悬崖边缘，更像是反恐行动而不是全面战争，

sentences.en: that is the definition of the kind of forever war presence, even if we're not taking significant casualties.
sentences.zh: 这就是所谓“永远的战争”存在的定义，即使我们没有承受重大伤亡。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, so far, we have not.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，到目前为止，我们还没有。

sentences.en: But that is exactly what his MAGA supporters were worried about with Iran, that we would go in and get stuck.
sentences.zh: 但这正是他的“让美国再次伟大”（MAGA）支持者对伊朗所担心的，即我们一旦卷入就会深陷泥潭。

sentences.en: David Zanger, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 大卫·赞格，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Always great to be with you, Rachel.
sentences.zh: 能和你一起聊聊总是很棒，瑞秋。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: A federal immigration agent shot and killed a person in a vehicle on Monday morning in Maine.
sentences.zh: 周一上午，联邦移民特工在缅因州的一辆汽车内枪杀了一人。

sentences.en: The second fatal shooting in a week involving an ICE agent firing into a vehicle.
sentences.zh: 这是内政部移民及海关执法局（ICE）特工在一周内发生的第二起向汽车开枪致死的事件。

sentences.en: Agents were looking for a person who was in the country illegally, according to a statement from the Department of Homeland Security,
sentences.zh: 根据国土安全部的一份声明，特工们当时在寻找一名非法在美居留的人，

sentences.en: and they stopped a vehicle belonging to what the agency described as a, quote, illegal alien.
sentences.zh: 并且他们拦截了一辆属于该机构所描述的“非法外侨”的汽车。

sentences.en: The agency claimed that the driver then, quote, weaponized his vehicle toward law enforcement, prompting an officer to open fire.
sentences.zh: 该机构声称，司机随后将他的汽车作为“武器”对准执法人员，促使一名警员开枪。

sentences.en: It was unclear whether the driver was the same person that agents were searching for.
sentences.zh: 目前尚不清楚该司机是否就是特工们正在搜寻的人。

sentences.en: No video footage had emerged as of Monday night to confirm the government's version of events.
sentences.zh: 截至周一晚间，尚未出现任何视频画面来证实政府对事件经过的说法。

sentences.en: And
sentences.zh: 还有

sentences.en: Lindsey took care of his little sister in years long departed.
sentences.zh: 多年前林赛曾悉心照顾过他的小妹妹。

sentences.en: It's my honor to ask his little sister, Darlene Graham, to finish his work for him now.
sentences.zh: 我很荣幸邀请他的小妹妹达琳·格雷厄姆现在为他完成未竟的工作。

sentences.en: Governor Henry McMaster of South Carolina said that he would appoint Senator Lindsey Graham's sister,
sentences.zh: 南卡罗来纳州州长亨利·麦克马斯特表示，在林赛·格雷厄姆周六逝世后，他将任命参议员格雷厄姆的妹妹

sentences.en: Darlene Graham Nordone, to finish his Senate term after Graham's death on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 达琳·格雷厄姆·诺多内来完成他的参议员任期。

sentences.en: McMaster said that he asked Nordone to fill the seat after they spoke immediately after Graham's death, and that she had accepted, quote, through tears.
sentences.zh: 麦克马斯特说，他在格雷厄姆逝世后立即与诺多内交谈，并邀请她填补这个席位，而她“含泪”接受了。

sentences.en: Lindsey has always been there for me.
sentences.zh: 林赛一直都在我身边。

sentences.en: And now I will be there for him.
sentences.zh: 现在我也将在他身边。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Asta Chaturvedi, Chris Benderev, and Rochelle Bonja.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由阿斯塔·查图维迪、克里斯·本德列夫和罗谢尔·邦贾制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Chris Haxel and Devin Taylor.
sentences.zh: 由克里斯·哈克塞尔和德文·泰勒编辑。

sentences.en: And contains music by Marian Lozano.
sentences.zh: 音乐由玛丽安·洛萨诺提供。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题曲由旺德利乐队创作。

sentences.en: This episode was engineered by Alyssa Moxley.
sentences.zh: 本期节目由艾莉莎·莫克利担任音频工程制作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Rachel AbraMs.
sentences.zh: 我是瑞秋·亚伯拉罕斯。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。
